bank_allocations_undo_chk.name: bank_allocations_undo_chk
bank_allocations_undo_chk.value: ("bank_allocations"."status" = 'desfeita' and "bank_allocations"."undone_by" is not null and "bank_allocations"."undone_at" is not null and "bank_allocations"."undo_reason" is not null) or ("bank_allocations"."status" = 'ativa' and "bank_allocations"."undone_by" is null and "bank_allocations"."undone_at" is null and "bank_allocations"."undo_reason" is null)

billing_batches_approval_chk.name: billing_batches_approval_chk
billing_batches_approval_chk.value: ("billing_batches"."status" = 'aprovado') = ("billing_batches"."approved_by" is not null and "billing_batches"."approved_at" is not null)

commission_statements_paid_chk.name: commission_statements_paid_chk
commission_statements_paid_chk.value: ("commission_statements"."status" = 'pago') = ("commission_statements"."paid_on" is not null and "commission_statements"."paid_by" is not null)

commission_statements_cancel_chk.name: commission_statements_cancel_chk
commission_statements_cancel_chk.value: ("commission_statements"."status" = 'cancelado') = ("commission_statements"."cancelled_by" is not null and "commission_statements"."cancelled_at" is not null and "commission_statements"."cancel_reason" is not null)

company_fiscal_formats_chk.name: company_fiscal_formats_chk
company_fiscal_formats_chk.value: ("company_fiscal"."cnae" is null or "company_fiscal"."cnae" ~ '^[0-9]{7}$') and ("company_fiscal"."city_ibge" is null or "company_fiscal"."city_ibge" ~ '^[0-9]{7}$') and ("company_fiscal"."cep" is null or "company_fiscal"."cep" ~ '^[0-9]{8}$') and ("company_fiscal"."uf" is null or "company_fiscal"."uf" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

company_fiscal_len_chk.name: company_fiscal_len_chk
company_fiscal_len_chk.value: char_length("company_fiscal"."accountant_name") <= 160 and char_length("company_fiscal"."accountant_document") <= 20 and char_length("company_fiscal"."accountant_crc") <= 30 and char_length("company_fiscal"."accountant_contact") <= 120 and char_length("company_fiscal"."accountant_email") <= 200 and char_length("company_fiscal"."accountant_phone") <= 30 and char_length("company_fiscal"."accountant_notes") <= 500 and char_length("company_fiscal"."municipal_registration") <= 30 and char_length("company_fiscal"."service_code") <= 10 and char_length("company_fiscal"."city_name") <= 80 and char_length("company_fiscal"."street") <= 160 and char_length("company_fiscal"."street_number") <= 20 and char_length("company_fiscal"."complement") <= 80 and char_length("company_fiscal"."district") <= 80 and char_length("company_fiscal"."phone") <= 30

contract_adjustment_rules_fixed_chk.name: contract_adjustment_rules_fixed_chk
contract_adjustment_rules_fixed_chk.value: ("contract_adjustment_rules"."index_code" = 'fixo') = ("contract_adjustment_rules"."fixed_bps" is not null) and ("contract_adjustment_rules"."fixed_bps" is null or "contract_adjustment_rules"."fixed_bps" between 0 and 10000)

contracts_commission_bps_chk.name: contracts_commission_bps_chk
contracts_commission_bps_chk.value: "contracts"."commission_bps" is null or ("contracts"."commission_bps" between 1 and 10000 and "contracts"."commission_partner" is not null)

generated.as: CASE WHEN legal_name ~* '^[0-9]{2}[.]?[0-9]{3}[.]?[0-9]{3}([/]?[0-9]{4}[-]?[0-9]{2})?( (ltda|s/?a|s[.]a[.]?|me|epp|eireli|slu))?[.]?$' AND coalesce(btrim(trade_name), '') <> '' THEN btrim(trade_name) ELSE legal_name END

customers_extras_chk.name: customers_extras_chk
customers_extras_chk.value:
("customers"."cep" is null or "customers"."cep" ~ '^[0-9]{8}$') and ("customers"."city_ibge" is null or "customers"."city_ibge" ~ '^[0-9]{7}$') and ("customers"."uf" is null or "customers"."uf" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
    and char_length("customers"."street") <= 160 and char_length("customers"."street_number") <= 20 and char_length("customers"."complement") <= 80 and char_length("customers"."district") <= 80 and char_length("customers"."city_name") <= 80
    and char_length("customers"."nf_text") <= 1000 and char_length("customers"."boleto_text") <= 400

email_accounts_text_chk.name: email_accounts_text_chk
email_accounts_text_chk.value: char_length("email_accounts"."host") <= 253 and char_length("email_accounts"."from_email") <= 200 and char_length("email_accounts"."from_name") <= 80 and char_length("email_accounts"."reply_to") <= 200

expense_applications_shape_chk.name: expense_applications_shape_chk
expense_applications_shape_chk.value: case "expense_applications"."kind" when 'conta_paga' then "expense_applications"."payable_id" is not null and "expense_applications"."payment_id" is not null and "expense_applications"."entry_id" is null when 'conta_aberta' then "expense_applications"."payable_id" is not null and "expense_applications"."payment_id" is null and "expense_applications"."entry_id" is null else "expense_applications"."entry_id" is not null and "expense_applications"."payable_id" is null and "expense_applications"."payment_id" is null end

expense_categories_text_chk.name: expense_categories_text_chk
expense_categories_text_chk.value: char_length("expense_categories"."name") between 2 and 60 and char_length("expense_categories"."grp") between 2 and 40 and "expense_categories"."code" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{2,40}$'

expense_rows_text_chk.name: expense_rows_text_chk
expense_rows_text_chk.value: char_length("expense_import_rows"."description") between 1 and 200 and ("expense_import_rows"."paid_raw" is null or char_length("expense_import_rows"."paid_raw") <= 40)

expense_rows_inst_chk.name: expense_rows_inst_chk
expense_rows_inst_chk.value: ("expense_import_rows"."installment_no" is null) = ("expense_import_rows"."installments_total" is null) and ("expense_import_rows"."installment_no" is null or ("expense_import_rows"."installment_no" between 1 and "expense_import_rows"."installments_total" and "expense_import_rows"."installments_total" between 2 and 999))

issuance_requests_done_chk.name: issuance_requests_done_chk
issuance_requests_done_chk.value: "issuance_requests"."status" not in ('emitido', 'processando') or "issuance_requests"."external_ref" is not null

messaging_settings_limits_chk.name: messaging_settings_limits_chk
messaging_settings_limits_chk.value: "messaging_settings"."max_per_run" between 1 and 500 and "messaging_settings"."max_per_hour" between 1 and 2000 and "messaging_settings"."max_late_days" between 0 and 30

partner_entries_reversal_chk.name: partner_entries_reversal_chk
partner_entries_reversal_chk.value: ("partner_entries"."status" = 'estornado' and "partner_entries"."reversed_by" is not null and "partner_entries"."reversed_at" is not null and char_length(btrim("partner_entries"."reverse_reason")) >= 3) or ("partner_entries"."status" = 'ativo' and "partner_entries"."reversed_by" is null and "partner_entries"."reversed_at" is null and "partner_entries"."reverse_reason" is null)

payable_payments_reversal_chk.name: payable_payments_reversal_chk
payable_payments_reversal_chk.value: ("payable_payments"."status" = 'estornado' and "payable_payments"."reversed_by" is not null and "payable_payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payable_payments"."reverse_reason" is not null) or ("payable_payments"."status" = 'ativo' and "payable_payments"."reversed_by" is null and "payable_payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payable_payments"."reverse_reason" is null)

payable_payments_text_chk.name: payable_payments_text_chk
payable_payments_text_chk.value: ("payable_payments"."reference" is null or char_length("payable_payments"."reference") <= 60) and ("payable_payments"."note" is null or char_length("payable_payments"."note") <= 200)

payable_templates_months_chk.name: payable_templates_months_chk
payable_templates_months_chk.value: extract(day from "payable_templates"."start_month") = 1 and ("payable_templates"."end_month" is null or (extract(day from "payable_templates"."end_month") = 1 and "payable_templates"."end_month" >= "payable_templates"."start_month"))

payables_doc_uq.name: payables_doc_uq
payables_doc_uq.where: "payables"."document_number" is not null and "payables"."status" not in ('cancelado', 'rejeitado')

payables_origin_chk.name: payables_origin_chk
payables_origin_chk.value: ("payables"."template_id" is null or ("payables"."series_id" is null and "payables"."competence" is not null)) and (("payables"."series_id" is null) = ("payables"."installment_no" is null))

payables_text_chk.name: payables_text_chk
payables_text_chk.value: char_length("payables"."description") between 2 and 200 and ("payables"."document_number" is null or char_length("payables"."document_number") between 1 and 40) and ("payables"."category" is null or char_length("payables"."category") <= 40)

payables_decision_chk.name: payables_decision_chk
payables_decision_chk.value: case when "payables"."status" in ('aprovado', 'rejeitado') then "payables"."decided_by" is not null and "payables"."decided_at" is not null when "payables"."status" in ('rascunho', 'aguardando_aprovacao') then "payables"."decided_by" is null else true end

payables_cancel_chk.name: payables_cancel_chk
payables_cancel_chk.value: ("payables"."status" = 'cancelado') = ("payables"."cancelled_by" is not null and "payables"."cancelled_at" is not null and "payables"."cancel_reason" is not null)

payments_reversal_chk.name: payments_reversal_chk
payments_reversal_chk.value: ("payments"."status" = 'estornado' and "payments"."reversed_by" is not null and "payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payments"."reverse_reason" is not null) or ("payments"."status" = 'ativo' and "payments"."reversed_by" is null and "payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payments"."reverse_reason" is null)

profit_settings_ranges_chk.name: profit_settings_ranges_chk
profit_settings_ranges_chk.value: "profit_settings"."delinquency_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "profit_settings"."unplanned_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "profit_settings"."retention_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "profit_settings"."reserve_months" between 0 and 24

profit_settings_cash_chk.name: profit_settings_cash_chk
profit_settings_cash_chk.value: ("profit_settings"."cash_now" is null) = ("profit_settings"."cash_as_of" is null) and ("profit_settings"."cash_now" is null or abs("profit_settings"."cash_now") <= 99999999999.99)
